name: glob-forms-vite-reads
description: An import.meta.glob call reads its globs as Vite does: a glob that starts with / against the project root, the directory of the nearest Vite configuration, a relative glob against the base option, itself relative to the calling file or, starting with /, to the project root, and a glob that starts with ! removing what it matches, so each file a glob matches is loaded with its exports and a file only a negated glob names is reported.
